pharma.title: Roche Asked to Revise Tecentriq SC Phase IV Trial Plan for Lung Cancer in India
pharma.summary: Indian drug regulatory authorities have directed pharmaceutical major Roche to revise its Phase IV clinical trial protocol for Tecentriq Subcutaneous (SC) intended for lung cancer treatment in India.

pharma.title: Torrent Emerges Early Leader in India's Generic Semaglutide Race with 38% Market Share
pharma.summary: Torrent Pharmaceuticals has emerged as an early market leader in India's generic semaglutide segment, capturing a 38% market share.

national.title: Yashasvi Jaiswal, Shafali Verma receive NADA notices for missed dope tests
national.summary: Indian cricketers Yashasvi Jaiswal and Shafali Verma have been issued notices by the National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA) regarding missed out-of-competition anti-doping tests.

national.title: Priyank Bharti Appointed Additional Secretary in MeitY, Given Additional Charge as NIC Director General
national.summary: Senior bureaucrat Priyank Bharti has been appointed as Additional Secretary in the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) with additional charge as Director General of the National Informatics Centre (NIC).

national.title: Bangladesh won't be 'football' between China and India: PM’s Adviser Kabir
national.summary: Bangladesh Prime Minister's Adviser Kabir emphasized that Bangladesh will maintain its strategic autonomy and will not become a competitive arena between China and India.

international.title: Non-tariff barriers now cost more than tariffs for most countries: UNCTAD
international.summary: A global trade assessment by UNCTAD revealed that non-tariff barriers have escalated to cost most trading nations significantly more than traditional tariffs.

international.title: Message by the WHO Director-General to the people of Tenerife regarding the hantavirus response
international.summary: The Director-General of the World Health Organization released an official address to the residents of Tenerife detailing international support and public health response protocols for hantavirus.

international.title: Russia holds downsized Victory Day parade
international.summary: Russia commemorated its annual Victory Day with a scaled-back military parade in Moscow amid ongoing strategic and security considerations.

economy.title: RBI Imposes Monetary Penalty On Yes Bank, Hinduja Housing Finance
economy.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has levied monetary penalties on Yes Bank and Hinduja Housing Finance for non-compliance with regulatory directives.

economy.title: Nifty, Sensex End Week Higher as Easing Crude Prices and Stronger Rupee Boost Sentiment
economy.summary: Indian benchmark indices Nifty and Sensex closed the week on a positive note, driven by falling international crude oil prices and a recovering Indian Rupee.

science.title: India completes 1,000 km secure quantum communication target under National Quantum Mission: Jitendra Singh
science.summary: Union Minister Jitendra Singh announced that India has successfully achieved its strategic milestone of establishing 1,000 km secure quantum communication under the National Quantum Mission.

science.title: Hantavirus poses no immediate public threat to India: ICMR-NIV Chief
science.summary: The Director of ICMR-National Institute of Virology (NIV) stated that international reports of hantavirus present no immediate threat to public health in India.

environment.title: Goa Declares 82 Lakh Square Metres As No Development Zone To Protect Hills
environment.summary: The Goa state government has classified 82 lakh square metres of land as a No Development Zone to protect ecologically sensitive hill slopes and prevent deforestation.

environment.title: India to Host 1st International Big Cat Summit
environment.summary: India is set to host the inaugural International Big Cat Summit aimed at strengthening global conservation efforts for seven major big cat species.

sports.title: India’s Richest Wrestler Pinned Outside Mat: How WFI Blocked Vinesh Phogat’s Dream Comeback
sports.summary: Reports highlighted administrative decisions by the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI) that prevented wrestler Vinesh Phogat from making a return to national competitive events.

sports.title: India Basketball League aims to build its own identity
sports.summary: The upcoming India Basketball League has unveiled plans to establish a standalone professional sports ecosystem to nurture basketball talent nationwide.

awards_honours.title: Zee Bhojpuri Samman 2026: Singer Maithili Thakur honoured with ‘Youth Icon of the Year’ award
awards_honours.summary: Folk singer Maithili Thakur was conferred the ‘Youth Icon of the Year’ title at the Zee Bhojpuri Samman 2026 for her contributions to traditional music.

awards_honours.title: AIIMS Bhopal surgeon wins global trauma surgery honour
awards_honours.summary: A senior surgeon from AIIMS Bhopal was recognized with a prestigious international surgical award for pioneering advances in emergency trauma surgery.

defence.title: Big defence boost: India tests Advanced Agni missile with MIRV capability successfully
defence.summary: India carried out a successful test launch of an advanced Agni strategic missile equipped with Multiple Independently Targetable Re-entry Vehicle (MIRV) technology.

defence.title: Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan appointed as next Chief of the Naval Staff
defence.summary: The Government of India has named Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan as the next Chief of the Naval Staff of the Indian Navy.

defence.title: Govt appoints Lt Gen N S Raja Subramani as Chief of Defence Staff
defence.summary: Lt Gen N S Raja Subramani has been appointed by the Central Government as the new Chief of Defence Staff (CDS).

schemes_appointments.title: PMSBY, PMJJBY & APY Milestone: Government’s Jan Suraksha schemes complete 11 years
schemes_appointments.summary: The Government of India's flagship financial inclusion schemes—PMSBY, PMJJBY, and Atal Pension Yojana (APY)—have completed 11 years of implementation.

schemes_appointments.title: Centre set to release Rs 2,700 crore in pending funds to West Bengal under Jal Jeevan mission
schemes_appointments.summary: The Union Government announced the upcoming release of Rs 2,700 crore in pending funds to West Bengal to accelerate piped water connectivity under the Jal Jeevan Mission.

schemes_appointments.title: SACHIN KURVE TRANSITIONS INTO A TOP TIER LEADERSHIP ROLE AS CHAIRMAN CHENNAI PORT AUTHORITY
schemes_appointments.summary: Senior bureaucrat Sachin Kurve has officially assumed charge as the Chairman of the Chennai Port Authority.

important_days.title: World Migratory Bird Day: Birds reveal the health of our world
important_days.summary: World Migratory Bird Day was observed globally to raise awareness regarding the preservation of migratory birds and their natural ecological habitats.

important_days.title: Rabindra Jayanti celebrated across the nation
important_days.summary: The birth anniversary of Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore was celebrated with cultural programs and tributes across educational and government institutions.
